headline: Silver Falls 5.94 Percent To $49.09 As Gold Drops 3.68 Percent To $3,883
narrative: Silver fell 5.94 percent to $49.09 and gold fell 3.68 percent to $3,883, money leaving the precious-metals pipe. The S&P 500 fell 1.82 percent to 7,580.07 and copper fell 1.32 percent to $6.49, while oil rose 0.81 percent to $102.83 and took the bid the metals gave up. Bitcoin traded near 77k as equities and industrial metal sold with that precious-metals pipe.
author: jordan
